MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: Who May Apply: Open to everyone. Applicants will be categorized by preference(s) and/or priority consideration eligibilities. An applicant's eligibility will be determined based on eligibility claimed in the questionnaire and proof of eligibility MUST be provided with application by the closing date, 08/03/2024 The Area of Consideration for this vacancy announcement must be US Citizens and legal US residents in/outside of the commuting area of Yokota AB, Japan. Legal US residents must possess a social security number. Must be able to provide documentation proving residence status overseas. Business Based Action Family Member Preference Military Spouse Preference Outside Applicant Veteran Spouse/Widow/Parent of Veteran Transition Hiring Preference In order to qualify, you must meet the experience requirements described below. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. Qualifying Experience: Must have experience in the production of professional video based medica to include technical and engineering expertise in the operation and utilization of a wide-variety of cameras and videos editing equipment software. Must be proficient with computers, peripheral devices, digital cameras, microphones, and video editing hardware/software. Incumbent must demonstrate, via portfolio or other acceptable means, their ability to perform successfully at this grade level. Must be able to demonstrate advanced knowledge of computer-aided editing software including Adobe Creative Suite, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing software and digital compression techniques. Must possess excellent oral and written communication skills. This position is a drug testing designated position; incumbent will be subject to random testing for drug use. Must be able to work nights, weekends, and holidays. Must have an approved means of travel (i.e. POV). Must be able to complete a Tier 1 background investigation.

Details.JobSummary: About the position: This position is located at the Marketing Facility, Yokota AB Japan. This is a Regular Full-Time position, 35-40 hours per week.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Thank you for considering employment with Air Force Services Non-Appropriated Funds (NAF). The 374 Force Support Squadron is a team of 1,000+ military, civilians and local nationals. We work together to provide enhanced quality of life for the 12,000 Yokota Air Base community members and over 150,000 transient personnel that visit Yokota every year via facilities and programs centered on morale, welfare, recreation and total force development. Our operations are the fourth largest in the Air Force: 13 dining facilities; personnel readiness and accountability; lodging; fitness; recreation; resiliency; child and youth programs; community building; mortuary affairs; NEO; Professional Development; and Education and Training. The squadron is comprised of eight flights, 49 activities and 159 facilities.
MajorDuties: Serves as the primary production manager for all video related content produced for 374th Force Support Squadron. Under the direction of the Marketing Director, the incumbent is responsible for directing, planning, producing, developing, writing, editing, coordinating, and publishing in-house video production. Develops and recommends guidelines for timely production of high-quality video presentations in conjunction with marketing team members. May coordinate and work closely with Armed Forces Network (AFN) on commercials or televised advertisements. Keeps abreast of all current technologies and trends in design and production. Incumbent is expected to understand and maintain a positive social media presence and assess the potential impact of emergent methods of interaction and their value to the FSS. Responsible for the creation and storage of all video backups. Works with the Marketing Director to assess future needs and schedules of events that will require coverage. Provides photogenic support for the FSS when needed. Completes troubleshooting and preventative maintenance reports on video and audio production equipment; assists in repair and upkeep of studio and production sets and properties. Maintains equipment inventory and acts as section equipment custodian if required. Edits footage filmed to create a clear and cohesive video that is engaging, informative, and clear. Generates ideas for video projects for the Marketing Department and 374 FSS. Plans and performs video post-production tasks, including reviewing footage, making editorial decisions, logging, rough cuts, audio adjustments, color correction, adding photographs, motion pictures, motion graphics animation, audio and music, and final editing using Adobe Creative Suite Software, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software. Uses computer graphics and special effects for video post-production in accordance with the overall production concepts; compresses/encodes video projects for output; makes video products in various formats; observes brand standards, ensures consistency and relevancy to production; monitors technical quality of end product; and coordinates internal and external duplication services as required. Commutes to and from assignment locations. Performs other related duties as assigned. If interested in this position please preview the online application: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/12495236
